about_the_game:
Dungeon Tracer: Demo

A modern reimagining of the classic puzzle RPG experience. Dungeon Tracer is a roguelike match-puzzle game inspired by the charm of retro gameplay.

In this demo, you can experience the core gameplay loop of combat, character growth, and dungeon exploration.

Game Features

Strategic Match Puzzle: Connect 3 or more blocks to remove them. The way you connect blocks determines their effect.

Block Types

Coin: Automatically opens the shop when enough are collected, allowing you to purchase gear.
Shield: Restores your gear’s durability. Leftover shields are converted into upgrade points.
Potion: Recovers HP.
Axe: Has no effect on its own, but when connected with enemy blocks, it increases attack power and deals additional damage.
Enemy: Grants experience points when removed. Enemies can also be attacked directly by connecting only enemy blocks, applying only your base attack power.

Progression System

Earn experience points to unlock skills.
You can equip up to 4 active skills. Passive skills are also available in this demo.

Special Enemies

As time passes, special enemies will appear. These enemies can transform or shuffle blocks, requiring careful strategy.

Demo Contents

Playtime: Approximately 20–30 minutes
Available Character: Adventurer
Skill System: A limited selection of active and passive skills is available

This demo supports auto-saving and resume functionality.
You can quit the game and continue later at any time.
However, save data from the demo cannot be transferred to the full version.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570T (2 cores, 2.9 GHz), or AMD A10-5800K equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2GB) or Radeon HD 7850 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card Any compatible sound device
